description: Profile ids that have been removed or deprecated from cx.profile.* and MUST NOT be declared in service describe claims, conformance reports, or implementation manifests. cotest scanner uses this list to detect downstream drift.

rejection_levels.hard_reject: MUST be rejected if declared by a current implementation.
rejection_levels.migration_only: MAY be tolerated as read-only legacy claim during migration window; new declarations MUST be rejected.
rejection_levels.compat_only: Allowed only on explicit interop / legacy compatibility surfaces.
rejection_levels.docs_only: Removed from machine surfaces; survives in CHANGELOG / migration notes.

allowed_context_definitions.changelog: Reference in CHANGELOG or migration documentation.
allowed_context_definitions.legacy_migration: Reference in code that translates legacy implementation manifests.
allowed_context_definitions.interop_module: Reference in an explicit interop binding (not core).
allowed_context_definitions.negative_test: Reference in cotest drift fixtures that assert rejection.

entries.notes: Single-modality profile ids never existed as canonical cx.profile.* entries; downstream (notably yougen) declared them informally. Use cx.profile.chat_mvp.v1 + the Realm's actual schema declaration to describe a chat-focused product.
See chat_only_client. Use cx.profile.kanban_mvp.v1; modality is expressed via Realm schema / morph_type_profiles, not via single-modality profile gating.
